editorial:
Imagine being a star athlete with your whole life planned out, only to have a bad knee ruin everything. That is exactly where you find David Morales. He is a smart, talented college student who just wants to make his mom proud, but without his scholarship, he is desperate for cash. When a creepy professor offers him huge sums of money to move sealed packages across the border, it seems like an easy win. The movie starts off as a slow burn but quickly turns into a high-stakes game of cat and mouse that keeps you guessing about what is actually inside those boxes.

You will love the tension and the way the action kicks into high gear once things go wrong. The acting is solid, and the pacing keeps the story moving so you never get bored. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the thrill of the chase makes it worth your time.
endingExplained: In the final act, you discover that Professor Darabont was using David as a disposable pawn for a massive drug operation. After a wild chase and a big shootout, David manages to outsmart the professor and the cartel. He uses his wits to turn the villains against each other. David eventually escapes with his life and some of the money, finally finding a way to secure his future without the scholarship.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime thrillers and underdog stories.
